data.name: Gaurav
data.gender_notes: Gaurav is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit garva, 'pride, honour, glory'. Its root is Sanskrit garv (गर्व्). A classical Sanskrit term for honour. Gaurav is a Sanskrit name meaning “Pride; honour; glory”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gaurav expresses “Pride; honour; glory”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit garva, 'pride, honour, glory'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gaurav total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'गौर' (gauR) which means 'Auspicious' or 'Radiant'. The name is also associated with Lord Ganesha and Lord Indra in Hindu mythology.
